FEDERAL EMPLOYEES BENEVOLENT FUND
FEDERAL EMPLOYEES BENEVOLENT
FUND
AND GROUP INSURANCE RULES,
1972
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
10th December, 2013]
S.R.O.
122(KE)/2012, dated 7-11-2012.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section
23 of the Federal Employees Benevolent Fund and Group Insurance Act, 1969 (II
of 1969), the Federal Government is pleased to direct that the following
further amendments/additions shall be made in the Federal Employees Benevolent
Fund and Group Insurance Rules, 1972 namely:--
2. In
the aforesaid rules--
(i) In
rule-6, after sub-rule (2), the following new sub-rules (3) and (4) shall be
added.
Sub-rule
(3). Every employee shall pay a monthly subscription to Benevolent Fund, in
terms of clause (c) of section 12 at the rates specified in column (4) of the
Sixth Schedule and monthly benevolent grant in terms of clause (3) of section
13 shall be paid in accordance with the scale prescribed in column (5) of the
Sixth Schedule, with effect from First
day of September, 2012.
Sub-rule
(4). The beneficiaries who are in recipient of monthly benevolent grant on
first day of September, 2012 shall be entitled to an increase equal to forty
percent of the grant with effect from First day of September, 2012 for the
remaining period of the grant.
(ii) In
rule-24, after sub-rule (1), the following new sub-rule (2) shall be added.
Sub-rule
(2). A sum equal to one month's pay shall be paid out of the
Benevolent Fund to
an employee if
he proceeds on
retiring pension after twenty years service on or after First day of
September, 2012.
3. This
Notification shall be deemed to have taken effect from 1st day of September,
2012.
